title: Causal Value Attribution of Marketing Labels in LLM-Generated Ads: A Deconfounder Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.23025v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As AI-generated content becomes commoditized, economic value increasingly shifts from final artifacts to the upstream expertise used to specify inputs that steer LLM generation. Yet organizations lack methods for valuing this expertise and identifying which individual skills or configurations causally improve performance. This study examines generative marketing, where structured expert labels serve as skill primitives conditioning LLM-generated advertisements. Estimating their causal effects is difficult because outcomes reflect stochastic LLM mediation, high-dimensional label interactions, and multimodal confounding. This study proposes D-VAE (Deconfounder Variational Autoencoder), a counterfactual-inference framework integrating a multi-treatment deconfounder with causal representation learning. translated_title: 大语言模型生成广告中营销标签的因果价值归因：一种去混淆因子方法
translated_abstract: 随着AI生成内容日益商品化，经济价值正逐渐从最终成品转移到用于指定输入以引导大语言模型（LLM）生成的上游专业知识。然而，组织缺乏评估这种专业知识价值的方法，也无法识别哪些具体技能或配置在因果意义上真正提升了绩效。本研究考察生成式营销领域，其中结构化的专家标签作为技能基元，用于条件化大语言模型生成的广告。估计这些标签的因果效应十分困难，因为结果反映了随机的大语言模型中介作用、高维标签交互以及多模态混淆。本研究提出了D-VAE（去混淆因子变分自编码器），这是一个将多处理去混淆因子方法与因果表征学习相结合的反事实推断框架。D-VAE恢复了因果解耦的专家标注逻辑，并推导出基于PAC（概率近似正确）的遗漏变量偏差界限，以应对单处理混淆带来的问题。
tldr: 本文提出D-VAE框架，将多处理去混淆因子方法与因果表征学习相结合，首次实现对LLM生成广告中专家营销标签因果价值的量化归因，解决了随机模型中介、高维标签交互与多模态混淆带来的估计难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes D-VAE, a counterfactual-inference framework integrating a multi-treatment deconfounder with causal representation learning, enabling causal value attribution of expert marketing labels in LLM-generated ads while addressing stochastic LLM mediation, high-dimensional label interactions, and multimodal confounding.
